■ G-Neo Evolution: You may put this creature on top of one of your light, water or darkness creatures.
Blocker
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature, draw 3 cards and discard up to 2 cards from your hand. For each discarded card, discard a card from your opponent's hand at random.
■ Whenever your opponent discards a spell, you may cast that spell from your opponent's graveyard for no cost.
testo_jp:
■ G-NEO進化：光、水、または闇のクリーチャー1体の上に置いてもよい。
Blocker
Double Breaker
■ このクリーチャーが出た時、カードを3枚引き、自分の手札を2枚まで捨てる。こうして捨てたカード1枚につき、相手の手札を1枚見ないで選び、捨てさせる。
